system.effect:
You become Trained in Acrobatics.
You gain Panache whenever you critically succeed on a Strike, or when you successfully Feint or Demoralize.
You can hold one Panache at a time and you keep it until you spend it or the encounter ends (whichever happens first).
While you have Panache you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Evade and a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds. At Expert rank, the Speed bonus increases to 10 feet. At Master rank, your Evade bonus increases to +2. At Legendary rank, your Speed bonus increases to 15 feet.
Every talent here requires this.
